pairs.why: Both coats have the same matte, clay-like finish, but A hangs on a proper wooden hanger and has a little more depth in its light, so it reads more like a real object.
The finishes are nearly identical, but B has a hanger on the hook, which makes the build more believable, while A's coat is just draped over the hook by its collar.
The two are almost the same; B's coat is slightly brighter with cleaner light, which is a bit closer to the vivid real cards.
A hangs on a hanger and its shading is a little richer, while B has no hanger and looks slightly flatter.
B hangs from a hanger, so it is built more like a real hanging coat; the rendering of the two is otherwise about the same.
These are close to identical; A has a slightly fuller shape and warmer light, but it is nearly a coin flip.
B's hanger hook sits cleanly on the wall hook, while A's hook is tangled awkwardly around it; the finish is otherwise equal.
B's hanger is attached to the hook more cleanly than A's tangled one; the finish and colour are otherwise the same.
